subject: Literature
title: Mary Wollstonecraft and the Rights of Women
description: Learn Mary Wollstonecraft and the Rights of Women in one minute.

hook.text: Mary Wollstonecraft wrote the founding text of feminism in 1792 and was vilified for it for over a century.

buildup.text: A Vindication of the Rights of Woman argued that women are not naturally inferior but are made so by lack of education.

discovery.text: She wrote it in just six weeks, furious that the French Revolution's 'rights of man' excluded half of humanity.

twist.text: After her death, her husband published her private life, and scandalized readers dismissed her ideas for a hundred years.

climax.text: Wollstonecraft's argument — that education, not nature, determines ability — became the foundation of all feminist thought.

punchline.text: She wrote feminism's founding text in six furious weeks.

quiz.question: What was Wollstonecraft's central argument in her Vindication?
options: Women should have the right to vote in elections
Women are not naturally inferior but are made so by lack of education
Women and men should live in separate societies
